title: A session that asks the batch runner to move a PR ahead of its queue is refused without an owner word
why: The coordinator asked a runner to put a PR ahead of the queue with no owner word behind it; a reorder is the owner's call and the runner then trusts a peer's message.
note: Filed by triage 11, 14:45 CST Nov 17 on the consultant's ask (14:41 CST), from the coordinator's mistakes list; a search of steps and open PRs found no existing guard. Prior work: priority-vs-merge-order (PR 3378). A guard step: a send_message to a runner that asks it to reorder or skip ahead of its queue is refused unless the message names an owner word with its time. Lane: test-author first (red case: a reorder ask with no owner word), then builder, review (a guard verdict). Mistake named, harm: the queue order changes with no owner word. Not started.
